entities.summary: Count Albrecht von Goertz, also known as Albrecht Goertz, was a German industrial designer who designed cars for BMW, including the BMW 503 and BMW 507. He also was an early contributor to the design of the legendary Toyota 2000GT and the first generation Nissan Silvia.
